name: agent-panel
description: Agent panels and ping-pong planning with Claude subagents at a chosen model and effort

runsDir.title: Runs folder (default ~/.claude/agent-panel/runs)
runsDir.description: Where each run keeps its answers and its discussion page, one folder per project and run. Leave it empty for ~/.claude/agent-panel/runs.

skillDirs.title: Default skill folders (e.g. ~/Code/my-skills)
skillDirs.description: Folders of <skill>/SKILL.md that +skill on a seat looks in, comma separated, for example ~/Code/my-skills. skills=<folder> on a command or a preset's own folders come first.
